notes.title: Release Week
notes.notes:
After an incredible four-year journey and feedback from over ten game conventions, we are thrilled to announce that Lighthaze World finally has a release date!
[p align="start"]Immerse yourself in a cozy puzzle adventure set in a charming, non-linear world. Explore serene landscapes inspired by our team's favorite real-life hiking trails, solve thoughtful puzzles, and help an anxious hero overcome their fears to rescue their loyal dog. It's the perfect escape for fans of relaxing, story-driven games.
[p align="start"]Mark your calendars:

Game Release: October 24th (North America) / October 25th (Australia & NZ)

Soundtrack Release: The following day! Composed by Tweaklab, "Breathe, Rest, Repeat" is a serene reimagining of the game's music—a calming album of ambient pads and gentle piano melodies designed to guide you into a state of deep calm.

Bundle: A game + soundtrack bundle will be available at launch!
[p align="start"]This has been a labor of love, and we can't wait for you to finally experience it.
